text:
Harper J: Quick heads-up — several interviewers for the Data Infra loop didn't receive scorecard links after the ATS sync.
Rohan M: Which req?
Harper J: REQ-9021, panel of 8. Hiring manager noticed blank scorecards when opening the panel.
Clara S: Any sync errors in the import job?
ats-sync-bot: [18:02] ATS bulk-import warning: row 5: unmatched email alias 'harper.j@personalmail.com' -> no ATS user match
Harper J: Ah — recruiters sometimes attach personal emails during outreach; the ATS canonical email is harper.j@redwood.ai. The sync matches strictly on email right now.
Drew T: That will drop the interviewer from the scorecard assignment step because we join on `interviewer_email` and skip unmatched rows.
Rohan M: Can we fallback to matching by `ats_user_id` if present, and otherwise attempt fuzzy-match on email local-part if the domain differs?
Clara S: We already capture `ats_user_id` in some exports but not all recruiters include it. Short-term patch: try `ats_user_id` first, then exact email, then local-part match with a whitelist of allowed domains.
Drew T: I can push a small change to the importer to implement that priority and add a Slack validation message when local-part matching is used.
Harper J: Timeline? Interviews start tomorrow morning.
Drew T: 30 minutes to deploy and run a targeted backfill for REQ-9021.
RecruiterBot: manual upload: file=req-9021-panel-export.csv queued for backfill by Clara S
ats-sync-bot: [18:25] backfill-job bf-2212345678-1 completed: 8 rows matched, 7 scorecards attached, 1 flagged (alias ambiguous)
Clara S: Confirmed — one interviewer had two different personal emails; I messaged the recruiter to confirm which to use.
Rohan M: Follow-ups: add a required-column check to the export template asking for `ats_user_id`, and add a short note in Recruiting Ops runbook about personal emails causing missed attachments.
Harper J: Also add a lightweight unit test for local-part matching to avoid false-positive merges.
Drew T: Will do. I'll also add an alert if >0 unmatched panel members after import so we can catch this earlier.
Clara S: Great — closing the loop, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
